frequency_type.description: 'daily' requires times; 'interval' requires interval_hours+anchor_at; 'weekly' requires times+weekdays

times.description: Comma-separated HH:mm values, e.g. "08:00,20:00". Required for daily/weekly.

interval_hours.description: Required for interval, e.g. 8 (every 8h) or 720 (every 30 days)

anchor_at.description: ISO instant of the first occurrence. Required for interval.
